'''Gilles Motais''' is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Motais was born in France and is currently a voice actor based in New York City. Motais joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|XY}}, where he gained the role of [[Monsieur Pierre]], which is his only role so far.
